resolutions.researcher_notes: Almerja.com (reposted transport-geography reference text): 'يوجد فى مصر شبكة واسعة من خطوط أنابيب نقل البترول تتولى ادارتها والاشراف عليها شركة أنابيب البترول التابعة للمؤسسة المصرية العامة للبترول' (Egypt's petroleum pipeline network is managed/supervised by the Petroleum Pipelines Company, a subsidiary of EGPC), then explicitly lists 'خط السويس/مسطرد، طوله 134كم' (Suez/Musturad line, 134km) among the country's main pipelines. Independently, the Ministry of Planning 'National Projects' brochure (PDF, text extracted via pdftotext -- url_verifier can't string-match inside PDF binary, hand-confirmed) itemizes two Petroleum-Sector renewal projects naming the Suez/Musturad line directly under 'شركة أنابيب البترول' (PPC): a 12in/42km mazut-line renewal and an 18in/55km products-line renewal, both on 'السويس/مسطرد'. Two independent sources both tie this specific pipeline to Petroleum Pipelines Company, EGPC's subsidiary -- supports Owner1=Egyptian General Petroleum Corp.
